approvedChange.scope: Only the 3D table source; measured fixed-context fit, existing scrollable fallback, and preservation of current round when the narrow header hides it.

findings.summary: At physical 681 by 377, density 1.75 and textScale 2.0, baseline fixed claim extends below the logical viewport and body height is zero. Final V2 uses a 103-unit body; actual scrollbar wheel input exposes the full claim and guidance, then each projected action.
V1 dropped the round number when the narrow header hid ROUND. Final V2 adds ROUND n within fallback public information under that same header-hide condition; directly verified in final captures.

layoutEvidence: Ordinary short layout: current round, complete claim/guidance, disabled Select cards and enabled Challenge Orbit are each fully exposed at recorded geometry.
Ordinary claim stays pinned at logical height 500 with a 235-unit body; duplicate long-name claim moves into a 388-unit body at that same height.
Duplicate long-name claim stays pinned at logical height 560 with a 247-unit body; ordinary tall height 688 has a 423-unit body.
The full action labels remain accessible by actual scrollbar wheel input for the specific tested layouts.
authorityAndPrivacyBoundary: Action callbacks, action enablement, hand visibility/erasure, controller, authority and diagnostic observer code remain unchanged.
Passive wheel probes emit only Ready, preserve revision 10 and empty selection, and erase private nodes at observed endpoints.
Strict scene tests cover intentional hand reveal/selection, cover, foreground and close; revealed screenshots legitimately show own-hand rank labels.
The previous-round disclosure remains separately labeled as public historical proof.
